Read successfully. Primary research documenting limitations of existing mitigations and proposing improvements.

evidence_items.publisher: AI Snake Oil, Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor

receipt.public_excerpt: Output filtering will also work for image generators.

evidence_items.explanation: The authors proposed output filtering and illustrated character recognition with nine examples. This establishes a contemporary technical argument, but neither identifies all the Twitter replies nor demonstrates reliable filtering across their intended scope.

The research finds existing safeguards incomplete while identifying more effective combinations. It cautions against treating all mitigation ideas as worthless, but does not test the unidentified replies or establish that a comprehensive fix was easy.

unresolved_gaps: The complete set of relevant Twitter replies was not recovered.
No matched evaluation establishes the effectiveness and implementation burden of each proposed remedy.
Failure to deploy an effective safeguard cannot establish that the safeguard was technically infeasible or difficult.
